items.title: Widerspruch against BAföG decision
items.quote: Wenn Sie diese Entscheidung überprüfen lassen möchten, legen Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach ihrer Bekanntgabe Widerspruch beim Studierendenwerk Mustertor, Mensaweg 2, 35392 Mustertor, ein – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter dated (posted) Monday 05.05.2025. Sender is a public-law institution (Anstalt des öffentlichen Rechts) acting as an administrative authority, posted after 1 Jan 2025, so delivery is deemed on the 4th calendar day after posting (§ 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG analog / general 4-day Bekanntgabefiktion): 05.05.2025 + 4 days = 09.05.2025 (Friday). This is not a tax office, so the delivery day does not shift even though it falls on a weekday anyway. The letterhead address (35392, phone area code 0641) corresponds to the Gießen area in Hesse (HE), so Hesse's public holidays apply for the objection period, not NRW's. One-month Widerspruch period under § 70 VwGO-type rule: per §§ 187, 188 BGB the day of delivery is not counted and the period ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day: 09.05.2025 → 09.06.2025 (Monday). 09.06.2025 is not a Saturday, Sunday or Hessian public holiday, so no shift applies.

items.title: Report changes in income, housing or studies immediately
items.quote: Änderungen bei Ihrem Einkommen, Ihrer Wohnung oder Ihrem Studium bitte sofort mit.
items.computation: The letter requires immediate ('sofort') notification of any future change in income, address or course of study. This is a standing obligation triggered by future events, not tied to a fixed calendar date, so no single due date can be computed from the letter alone.

warnings: The Widerspruch deadline computed from the letter (2025-06-09) already lies more than a year before today's date (2026-10-06); if this letter was in fact received only recently, double-check the actual posting/delivery date, since as printed the objection period has long since expired.

The letterhead postal code (35392) and phone area code (0641) point to the Gießen area in Hesse, not to the recipient's registered Land (NRW) or the recipient's own address region (looks like Baden-Württemberg); Hesse's public holidays were used for the deadline since that is where the office sits, but this mismatch of regions is unusual and worth double-checking.

The monthly BAföG payment amount and schedule ('Die Zahlung erfolgt jeweils zum Monatsende für den folgenden Monat') describes recurring payments to the student but sets no specific obligation with a due date for the recipient, so no payment item was created for it.
